text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction linking this ayah to the prior relative characterization
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes linkage the ayah's first move. It carries the characterization from 13:21 into a renewed relative clause, so alladhīna and its virtues are heard as continuation rather than as a detached new subject.

topics.headline: boundary continuation before the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by carrying an unfinished description forward before naming new actions.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction is licensed as coordination/resumption, and the verdict clause later resolves the carried chain.

topics.headline: proclitic link fused to the relative pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the boundary connection is attached directly to the relative frame.
topics.reason: The written proclitic makes the connector part of the first surface unit of the new relative clause.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun defining a class by listed actions
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) turns the praised people into an action-defined class. The pronoun is definite and plural, but it withholds the verdict until the sequence of endurance, prayer, spending, and repelling evil has been gathered and pointed back to by ūlāʾika.

topics.headline: definite class defined by actions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that identity here is grammatical and behavioral, not a name or lineage.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the plural subject whose predicates define the group.

topics.headline: relative frame delays the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah accumulate qualities before the reward clause arrives.
topics.reason: The headed relative clause remains open until the later demonstrative and possession predicate.

words.gloss_range: absolute perfect endurance as the foundational completed stance
words.root_gloss_range: broad range of endurance, restraint, binding, hardness, and bitter durability; locally selected as disciplined endurance
words.prose: {{ar:صَبَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:ṣabarū}}) is the first lexical verb and it appears absolutely, without naming a single endured object. Its root pressure makes patience active restraint and hard self-binding, while the perfect plural presents it as the settled foundation before prayer, spending, and the ongoing work of yadraʾūna. That opening patience also belongs to the good-repelling virtue cluster seen at 28:54 and is answered by the reward explanation at 13:24.

topics.headline: unstated object broadens endurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that endurance is not limited to one hardship; it becomes the entry condition for the whole virtue list.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as perfect plural and the attachment profile treats it as the first predicate of the descriptive sequence.

topics.headline: restraint and hardness inside patience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses patience as controlled firmness rather than passive waiting.
topics.reason: V4/Lane evidence supports binding, restraint, bitter aloe, and hard stone imagery, while local syntax selects endurance rather than every root branch.

topics.headline: perfect plural settled commitment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees endurance as a collective settled stance before the later imperfect habit.
topics.reason: The perfect aspect and plural suffix bind the action to the relative plural group.

topics.headline: patience links to good-response and reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this opening patience is tied to the later good-repelling formula and to the reward explanation at 13:24.
topics.reason: The supplied cross references connect patience with good-response patterns such as 28:54 and with the same root returning at 13:24.

words.gloss_range: accusative Form VIII verbal noun giving the purpose of endurance
words.root_gloss_range: broad seeking and overreach range; locally narrowed to disciplined seeking by its divine-facing target
words.prose: {{ar:ٱبْتِغَآءَ}} ({{tr:ibtighāʾa}}) is an accusative purpose expression: endurance is for seeking, not just endurance by itself. Because the root can move from desire into overreach, the phrase is narrowed by its target, wajhi rabbihim, into self-involved and disciplined pursuit. That same targeting makes it recognizable sincerity language, with the surah-local root pressure redirected from the excess/overflow field at 13:17.

topics.headline: purpose fused to endurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience has an explicit motive built into the grammar.
topics.reason: The accusative maṣdar functions as a purpose accusative modifying the first verb and governing the following construct target.

topics.headline: desire root ethically directed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees desire redirected into legitimate pursuit rather than grasping transgression.
topics.reason: The broader root range includes transgressive overreach, but Form VIII and the governed target select earnest seeking here.

topics.headline: recognizable sincerity construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as part of a wider sincerity formula while still local to this ayah.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and surah-local evidence connect the seeking-root with face and Lord formulas.

words.gloss_range: construct target of seeking: face, direction, orientation, and essence held together
words.root_gloss_range: broad face/front/direction/aspect/essence range; locally active as the divine-facing target of seeking
words.prose: {{ar:وَجْهِ}} ({{tr:wajhi}}) is the governed target inside the purpose phrase. Its construct form makes the sought aim definite through rabbihim, and its lexical range keeps face, front, direction, and essential orientation together without turning the phrase into vague aspiration. The wording also keeps the face-seeking sincerity formula visible through parallels such as 18:28, 6:52, and 92:20.

topics.headline: construct target completed by Lord relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the motive is grammatically aimed, not left as free-floating devotion.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the construct chain and makes this word the governed object of the seeking expression.

topics.headline: face and direction remain live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the motive as concrete orientation toward the Lord, not just an abstract intention.
topics.reason: The evidence supports face/front, direction, and essence, while the local phrase selects those pressures as the target of seeking.

topics.headline: face-seeking as sincerity marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as a devotional sincerity formula with concrete parallels such as 18:28, 6:52, and 92:20.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah rows give face-seeking parallels and the local wording ties them to the characterized group.

words.gloss_range: possessive Lord relation closing the motive chain
words.root_gloss_range: ownership, authority, nurturing, and completion; locally the group-specific Lord whose face is sought
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) closes the construct chain with a plural possessive suffix. The Lord is not named generically: He is their owner-nurturer, the one sought at the opening motive and implicitly master of the final al-dāri. The same Lord-relation moves from fear in 13:21 into sought orientation here, so awe and pursuit stay joined.

topics.headline: suffix binds Lord to the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the motive belongs to this group’s lived Lord-relation.
topics.reason: The suffix closes the iḍāfa and routes the relation back to the plural relative subject.

topics.headline: Lord relation anticipates the abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening Lord relation as connected to the final abode, not only to inner piety.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports ownership and nurturing authority; local wording links that relation to the ayah’s closing reward domain.

topics.headline: feared Lord becomes sought Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from fearing the Lord in 13:21 to seeking His face in 13:22.
topics.reason: Boundary and co-occurrence rows supply the Lord-relation network and concrete comparison with 13:18 and 13:21.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding prayer-establishment as a separate completed predicate
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) attaches aqāmū to the endurance clause as a second completed quality. The connector keeps prayer-establishment additive and cumulative, not merely an explanation of ṣabarū.

topics.headline: prayer added as a separate quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the list grow from inward endurance into ritual establishment without collapsing the two predicates.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second perfect verb with the first in the same descriptive sequence.

words.gloss_range: Form IV causative establishment of the definite prayer institution
words.root_gloss_range: standing, uprightness, maintaining, straightening; locally causative establishment of prayer
words.prose: {{ar:أَقَامُوا۟}} ({{tr:aqāmū}}) takes the definite object al-ṣalāta, so the q-w-m standing image is directed onto the prayer institution. The Form IV verb makes the group agents who make prayer stand as a maintained practice, and its perfect form aligns it with the settled commitments before the later imperfect clause. It also carries the familiar prayer-establishment formula seen at 2:3, 2:43, and 2:277, folded here into this completed-commitment series.

topics.headline: establishment locked to prayer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the establishment force is aimed at the known prayer institution.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the verb as transitive with the definite object immediately following.

topics.headline: causing prayer to stand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures prayer as an upheld structure rather than a passing act.
topics.reason: The root range supports standing and uprightness; local Form IV selects causative establishment rather than bare standing or Form II correction.

topics.headline: prayer formula paired with spending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar prayer-establishment formula is one completed commitment among several.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence evidence gives the established formula, while the local aspect and sound parallel bind it to the list.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative prayer object, the institution made to stand
words.root_gloss_range: prayer, worship, invocation, connection, close-following; locally the recognized ritual institution
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣalāta}}) is the accusative object that aqāmū makes stand. Its definiteness selects the recognized prayer institution, while the root evidence lets that institution carry connection, worship, and close-following as the God-directed axis before spending opens the social axis.

topics.headline: prayer as what is established
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is not loose supplication but the recognized prayer institution.
topics.reason: Case, definiteness, and the q-w-m collocation constrain the local sense.

topics.headline: prayer as maintained relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears established prayer as a maintained channel of nearness and following.
topics.reason: The derivational pressure is relevant, but the local object slot selects ritual prayer rather than every etymological path.

topics.headline: prayer before spending broadens the profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the list move from God-directed practice into community-directed expenditure.
topics.reason: The sequence places prayer before spending, supporting the vertical/horizontal distribution.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction carrying the list from prayer into spending
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the cumulative list from al-ṣalāta into anfaqū. It keeps material redistribution separate from prayer while binding the two as adjacent completed duties.

topics.headline: spending added after prayer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from worship to resources as one continuous virtue sequence.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the spending verb with the prior prayer-establishment predicate.

words.gloss_range: Form IV spending as partitive channeling from given provision
words.root_gloss_range: passage, spending, tunnel, exhaustion, hypocrisy; locally legitimate outward channeling of provision
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفَقُوا۟}} ({{tr:anfaqū}}) is followed by mimmā, so the spending is from what was granted, not total depletion. The n-f-q passage image makes the act a channeling outward of provision, and the secret/open modes later keep the channel comprehensive across disclosure settings.

topics.headline: spending from provision, not all provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that giving is framed as redistribution from a prior grant.
topics.reason: The following partitive construction and provision verb constrain the spending source.

topics.headline: resources pass outward through the giver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spending as making provision pass through, not merely losing wealth.
topics.reason: The root family includes passage, tunnel, spending, exhaustion, and hypocrisy; local Form IV selects caused outward expenditure.

topics.headline: settled giving across disclosure modes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spending is a settled trait expanded across secret and open modes.
topics.reason: The perfect aspect aligns with the earlier completed predicates, and the following manner accusatives govern disclosure range.

words.gloss_range: fused source-preposition and relative pronoun opening the provision domain
words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) compresses source and relative content into one surface unit. The prepositional side makes spending partitive, while the relative side leaves the provided resource open enough to include any beneficial grant that razaqnāhum names as divine provision.

topics.headline: from-what source of spending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the resource is both sourced and open-ended: they spend from whatever God has provided.
topics.reason: The segmentation is source preposition plus relative pronoun, governing the provision clause.

words.gloss_range: divine perfect provision with recipients attached before they redistribute
words.root_gloss_range: beneficial grant and sustenance; locally a prior divine allocation to the group
words.prose: {{ar:رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:razaqnāhum}}) inserts the divine first-person provider into the third-person virtue list. Its attached pronouns compress giver and recipients, so the group’s anfaqū becomes downstream redistribution of a prior divine grant rather than self-originating generosity.

topics.headline: We provided them before they spend
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the provision chain: God grants first, then the group gives from it.
topics.reason: The morphology contains divine first-person plural, human object pronoun, and perfect aspect.

topics.headline: provision as broad beneficial grant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees what is spent as any received capacity, not only money.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence broadens provision, while the local clause selects concrete granted resources that become expenditure.

topics.headline: divine voice enters the virtue list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a register shift where God speaks as provider inside the description of the faithful.
topics.reason: The supplied discourse and formula rows connect this provision-spending construction to faithful-spending patterns and later 13:26.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative mode of secret giving
words.root_gloss_range: secrecy, interiority, joy, and choicest inner part; locally private mode of giving
words.prose: {{ar:سِرًّا}} ({{tr:sirran}}) marks secret giving as a manner or state of anfaqū. Its indefinite accusative form generalizes the mode, while the s-r-r range adds interiority and choicest inner quality before ʿalāniyatan supplies the open pole of the pair. The paired disclosure spectrum also belongs to the charity-mode formula seen at 14:31, 2:274, and 35:29.

topics.headline: secret as manner of spending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that secrecy modifies how they give, not what they give.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite accusative manner/state parallel to the following public mode.

topics.headline: hidden giving with inner-quality pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses private giving as inward and choice, not merely unseen.
topics.reason: The lexical range includes secrecy, joy, innermost, and best part; local grammar keeps it as an adverbial mode.

topics.headline: recognized disclosure spectrum
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees secret and open giving as a total disclosure spectrum with parallels such as 14:31, 2:274, and 35:29.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and inter-ayah rows support the secret/open charity formula, and the matching cadence reinforces the pair.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction pairing the secret and open modes
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pairs sirran with ʿalāniyatan under the same spending verb. The connector makes the two modes equal poles of one disclosure range instead of letting public giving replace private giving.

topics.headline: hidden and open joined as a totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the spending profile spans both disclosure poles.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates two parallel manner accusatives under the same verb.

words.gloss_range: parallel accusative public mode completing the disclosure pair
words.root_gloss_range: manifest, public, openly visible; locally the open mode of giving
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَانِيَةً}} ({{tr:ʿalāniyatan}}) matches sirran as an indefinite accusative manner. The word selects visible disclosure rather than mere proclamation, and its uncommon form is strongest here as the second pole of the secret/open spending formula, with close spending parallels at 2:274, 14:31, and 35:29.

topics.headline: public mode under the spending verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that open giving is grammatically parallel to secret giving.
topics.reason: Case and conjunction lock the word to the same adverbial function as the secret mode.

topics.headline: visible disclosure as lexical opposite
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pair as a compact antonymic range from concealed to manifest.
topics.reason: The semantics and distribution show the root dominated by the secret/open pairing.

topics.headline: rare public-giving form in charity parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unusual form belongs to a constrained charity formula with parallels at 2:274, 14:31, and 35:29.
topics.reason: The form-class evidence and supplied parallels support formulaic weight without changing the local adverbial parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction introducing the final verb across an aspect shift
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps yadraʾūna inside the same virtue list even though the verb shifts to imperfect. The connector lets the ayah move from settled commitments into ongoing response without starting a new discourse unit.

topics.headline: continuity at the tense break
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final ongoing practice still belongs to the same characterization.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the imperfect verb with the earlier perfect predicates.

words.gloss_range: imperfect direct repelling of evil with good as instrument
words.root_gloss_range: rare root of pushing away and, secondarily, pushing together; locally active moral deflection
words.prose: {{ar:يَدْرَءُونَ}} ({{tr:yadraʾūna}}) is the aspect pivot of the ayah: after completed commitments, this imperfect presents an ongoing habit. Its frame is compact and method-marked, with al-ḥasanati as the instrument and al-sayyiʾata as the object, so evil is actively deflected by good rather than merely avoided. Because the rare d-r-ʾ verb clusters with patience, spending, good, and evil, the clause reactivates the ethical formula especially visible at 28:54.

topics.headline: imperfect after perfect commitments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from settled traits to continuing ethical response.
topics.reason: The imperfect Form I follows three perfect verbs and remains directly coordinated with them.

topics.headline: good as tool, evil as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the moral grammar: good is the means, evil is what is acted upon.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence and case marking identify the instrument phrase and direct object.

topics.headline: pushing away with creative pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the act as forceful deflection, with a hint of transforming pressure rather than passive avoidance.
topics.reason: The root evidence includes repelling and fire-stoking, but local syntax selects repelling evil.

topics.headline: rare verb concentrates the virtue network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare verb gathers patience, spending, good, and evil into a known ethical formula, especially in 28:54.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and rarity rows tie this local verb to the ayah’s broader virtue network.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition making good the means of repelling
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns al-ḥasanati into the operative means of yadraʾūna. Because the instrument phrase comes before al-sayyiʾata, the ayah foregrounds the method of response before naming the evil being repelled.

topics.headline: good marked as tool before evil appears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that good is not just present; it is the channel and tool by which evil is pushed back.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the good into an instrumental phrase that precedes the direct object.

words.gloss_range: definite singular good/beautiful act used as instrument
words.root_gloss_range: ethical goodness, beauty, improvement, and excellence; locally the known good response
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَسَنَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥasanati}}) is genitive under bi, so the good is the instrument rather than the thing repelled. Its definite singular form names the known category of good and beautiful response, matching al-sayyiʾata in form while opposing it in value. The matched good/evil opposition also joins counteraction parallels such as 41:34 and 11:114.

topics.headline: definite good governed by the instrumental bāʾ
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the method is placed first: good is the means before evil is named.
topics.reason: Case government and word order make the good the fronted instrument of the repelling action.

topics.headline: goodness as beautiful improving action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears good as both morally right and beautiful, an improving intervention against harm.
topics.reason: The root range joins beauty, goodness, and excellence; local syntax selects the good response as instrument.

topics.headline: good opposed to evil in a known formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the matched good/evil opposition and its counteraction parallels such as 41:34 and 11:114.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence, shape, sound, and inter-ayah rows support a systematic moral-aesthetic pair.

words.gloss_range: definite singular evil/ugly object repelled by good
words.root_gloss_range: evil, harm, ugliness, shame, and exposure; locally the recognized evil object of repelling
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ}} ({{tr:al-sayyiʾata}}) is the accusative object that yadraʾūna acts upon. Its definiteness and singular abstract form make evil a recognized category, and the s-w-ʾ range adds ugliness and shame to what the good response pushes away. The same field shifts from feared bad reckoning in 13:21 to a present evil object actively repelled here.

topics.headline: definite evil acted upon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that evil is not the instrument or background; it is the object being repelled.
topics.reason: The accusative case and direct-object relation are syntactically forced.

topics.headline: evil as bad, ugly, and disgrace-bearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the repelled thing as morally bad, aesthetically ugly, and shame-bearing.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports harm, ugliness, and shame, while local syntax selects the evil object in the good-response frame.

topics.headline: evil answered by good across the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from fearing bad reckoning in 13:21 to actively repelling evil in 13:22.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect the good/evil pair and the surah-local movement from bad reckoning to present moral action.

words.gloss_range: far demonstrative gathering the described class for the verdict
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ūlāʾika}}) stops the list and points back to the whole action-defined class. Its far demonstrative force gathers the predicates into one elevated pointer, opening the verdict clause where la hum assigns the outcome.

topics.headline: pointer gathers the whole relative chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from listing qualities to identifying the group as ready for judgment.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is definite, plural, and points back to the accumulated predicates.

topics.headline: description turns into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the grammar resolve the suspended relative characterization from 13:21 into reward.
topics.reason: The demonstrative-verdict clause supplies the predicate resolution for the prior relative chain.

words.gloss_range: fronted lām assigning possession-benefit before the reward noun
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the fronted possession-benefit phrase. Before ʿuqbā is named, the grammar has already assigned the outcome to the group through hum.

topics.headline: entitlement before outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward arrives already allocated: the final outcome is for them.
topics.reason: The lām governs the pronoun and the fronted prepositional predicate precedes the delayed outcome noun.

words.gloss_range: plural pronoun routing the verdict back to the described group
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the beneficiaries visible inside the verdict. It routes the reward back through ūlāʾika to alladhīna, so the final clause belongs to the same group defined by every preceding action.

topics.headline: pronoun returns verdict to the relative group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no new subject appears at the reward; the same characterized group receives it.
topics.reason: The segmented pronoun is governed by the lām and refers back to the demonstrative and relative chain.

words.gloss_range: compact emphatic final outcome bound to the abode
words.root_gloss_range: consequence, succession, heel-following, and punishment; locally final rewarded outcome rather than punitive retribution
words.prose: {{ar:عُقْبَى}} ({{tr:ʿuqbā}}) names the delayed outcome after the beneficiaries have already been fronted. Its construct with al-dāri makes the reward the abode’s final consequence, and the compact form folds the whole four-part virtue list into a two-word verdict. That phrase begins a local reward refrain fulfilled in praise at 13:24 and widened again at 13:42.

topics.headline: outcome bound to the abode after fronted beneficiaries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is not abstract success but the final outcome of the abode.
topics.reason: The word is the first term of the construct and the delayed subject/content after the fronted possession phrase.

topics.headline: consequence that follows on action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses outcome as what follows on the heels of the ayah’s actions.
topics.reason: The root range includes heel, following, succession, consequence, and punishment; local construct selects final consequence.

topics.headline: short emphatic form at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a heavier compact verdict rather than a more common outcome noun.
topics.reason: The supplied morphology distinguishes the form from broader outcome derivatives and marks rarity/emphasis.

topics.headline: virtue list compressed into a local reward refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this phrase resolving the action list and anticipating its praise-formula fulfillment at 13:24 and wider outcome use at 13:42.
topics.reason: The structural and inter-ayah rows identify the phrase as a compressed verdict and surah-local refrain.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive final abode completing the reward phrase
words.root_gloss_range: dwelling, realm, domain, cycle, and turning; locally the known final abode/domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدَّارِ}} ({{tr:al-dāri}}) is the final governed word of the ayah. Its definiteness assumes a known final abode, while the d-w-r domain and cycle pressure makes the ending feel like the place where the whole sequence comes round to its consequence. The positive abode closure stands against the bad-abode counterpoint at 13:25, participates in the outcome formula at 13:24 and 13:42, and rings back to the opening Lord relation as master of the house.

topics.headline: known final abode as genitive complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing word is a known, governed domain, not an unspecified place.
topics.reason: The word is definite, singular, and genitive as complement of the outcome noun.

topics.headline: abode as domain where the process completes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the abode as the domain where the ayah’s actions come full circle.
topics.reason: The root range includes dwelling, realm, revolving, epoch, and cycle; local wording selects the known final abode.

topics.headline: positive abode pole in local contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this positive abode phrase as one pole of a surah-local contrast with the bad abode at 13:25 and related outcome formulas at 13:24 and 13:42.
topics.reason: The supplied rows link the phrase to 13:24, 13:25, 13:35, 13:42, and 28:83 as outcome language.

topics.headline: opening Lord relation returns in final abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on the abode while remembering the opening Lord relation as master of the house.
topics.reason: The final-word position, owner-abode rows, and sound row support the closing function without changing the genitive parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from endurance through seeking, maintained prayer, two visibility modes of giving, and ongoing moral counteraction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Endurance holds the self steady under one governing direction; prayer maintains that direction, and giving remains continuous whether concealed or observed. The list therefore behaves as one visibility-invariant regimen rather than unrelated virtues.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the held inner posture and makes endurance active rather than mere delay.
Directed seeking supplies an explicit object of desire and gives the endurance its aim.
Direction and destination supply the governing orientation toward which the practices are aligned.
Care, preservation, and oversight supply sustained maintenance, so prayer is kept operative.
Concealment in the interior supplies the unobserved mode in which the same giving continues.
Manifest visibility supplies the observed mode and tests continuity of purpose across exposure.

changed_reading.before: A catalog of patience, prayer, charity, and good conduct.
changed_reading.after: A single directed discipline whose orientation and generosity remain stable when no one sees and when everyone can see.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive source of provision, spending from only part of what was supplied, and goodness acting against injury.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord nurtures and apportions; provision then exits the recipients instead of terminating in them. Beneficent action is the medium used against what harms, so the agents function as stewards who keep received good moving onward.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion supply the upstream relation from which the regimen is sustained.
The departure of wealth in expenditure supplies outward transfer rather than retained possession.
A passage with an outlet supplies a circulation image for provision moving through its recipient.
An apportioned gift supplies the incoming resource and limits any claim of self-originating ownership.
Beneficent action toward another supplies the active counter-medium rather than a merely attractive quality.
What grieves or injures supplies the adverse force that the good action meets.
The final consequence supplied by the branch makes the dwelling the result of the circuit's operation.

changed_reading.before: People give some privately owned wealth and are later rewarded.
changed_reading.after: Recipients of an allotment become conduits: they release provision and convert encounters with injury into further beneficent action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing construction joins an aftermath to a dwelling after a sequence of repeated practices.
baseline_models.mechanism: What follows an act can be a succession, remainder, or recurring return, while a dwelling can enclose, circulate around, and identify its resident. The ethical sequence can therefore be read as accumulating an after-condition that eventually becomes habitable.

activation_trace.role: Successive coming-after supplies a temporal chain linking repeated practices to what follows them.
A remainder or persistent trace supplies the accumulated material of the eventual condition.
Circulation and enclosure supply the spatial conversion of repeated consequences into an environment.
Residence and belonging to a dwelling supply the endpoint as inhabitation, not a detached prize.

changed_reading.before: A good final residence is appended as compensation for the listed deeds.
changed_reading.after: The deeds leave successive traces that gather into the very after-condition their agents will inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier demand accelerates bad ahead of good; the focus reverses both sequence and agency by placing good in the instrumental position against bad. Good action becomes an interruption of a destructive temporal order.

activation_trace.role: Hastening and putting forward supply the accelerated timing that the focus later interrupts.
Precedence and approach supply the explicit bad-before-good ordering that is reversed in the focus.
The distressing or injurious item supplies the pole demanded first in the earlier sequence.
Beneficent action supplies the delayed pole that the focus instead advances as its instrument.

structural_cues: 13:6 orders bad before good, whereas 13:22 grammatically makes good the instrument acting on bad.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit earlier order and the focus supplies the inverted instrumental construction; I infer a deliberate ethical counter-order. A live alternative is that the two clauses only share conventional opposites.

changed_reading.before: Responding to a bad act with a good one.
changed_reading.after: Interrupting the rush toward harm by putting beneficent action first and making it govern what happens next.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge spans what is absent from sight and what is witnessed, then the next ayah equalizes concealed and declared speech. Secret and public giving consequently become two observer states under one audit, strengthening the baseline's claim of stable orientation.

activation_trace.role: Being screened from eyes supplies the unobserved state covered by divine knowledge.
Presence with witnessing supplies the observed state paired with the unseen.
Interior concealment supplies a contextual instance of action hidden from other people.
Public declaration supplies the exposed counterpart and completes the visibility test.

structural_cues: The unseen/witnessed pair in 13:9 is immediately enacted as concealed/declared speech in 13:10 and recurs as secret/public giving in 13:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three aligned visibility binaries; I infer that the focus tests invariance of purpose across them. The alternative is a simple enumeration of permissible giving modes without an integrity test.

changed_reading.before: Giving may appropriately be private or public.
changed_reading.after: Giving is run through both hidden and exposed conditions to show that its direction does not depend on an audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The futile image stretches open palms toward water in an attempt to acquire, yet nothing reaches the mouth. The focus reverses the vector: provision is released from the holder, making generosity an effective outward reach rather than an empty acquisitive gesture.

activation_trace.role: Extending and opening the hand supplies the bodily gesture whose direction is reversed by spending.
The literal palm supplies the receiving surface that remains ineffective when it only reaches to acquire.
Arrival at a destination supplies the failed efficacy test: the water never reaches its intended end.
Wealth leaving in expenditure supplies the opposite vector, an outward transfer that can actually reach beyond the self.

structural_cues: The 13:14 simile extends palms toward water but twice denies arrival to the mouth; 13:22 sends received provision away from its holder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed inward acquisition and successful outward expenditure; I infer a reversal of the hand's vector. The live alternative is that the simile concerns false invocation only and has no bearing on giving.

changed_reading.before: Spending is the charitable use of one's hand and wealth.
changed_reading.after: The hand becomes effective when it stops grasping toward itself and releases provision toward a destination beyond itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water is routed through channels by capacity and fire processes material; in both, raised foam is cast away while benefit remains. The repeated seeking term contrasts ornament or utility with the focus's higher direction, and good acting on bad becomes a selective process that removes waste while preserving what can remain.

activation_trace.role: A valley as the path of a flood supplies the channel through which mixed material is processed.
A bounded measure supplies differentiated carrying capacity rather than undirected abundance.
Floating foam supplies the prominent but non-enduring layer separated from the useful flow.
Purposeful seeking supplies the shared motive-form while its object shifts to ornament or utility.
Castoff refuse supplies the removal endpoint for what only floated on the process.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion for what deserves preservation.
Remaining steadily with time supplies the durable residue that the moral process seeks.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats the focus's seeking form with ornament/utility as its object, then contrasts floating discard with benefit that remains after water and fire processes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies channels, capacity, foam, discard, and durable benefit; I map that process onto good displacing bad in the focus. The alternative is that the process illustrates truth and falsehood only, with no transfer to the focus's ethics.

changed_reading.before: Good behavior replaces or compensates for bad behavior.
changed_reading.after: Good is a processing medium: it routes a mixed event through capacity, ejects the harmful froth, and preserves durable benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is enclosed by fulfillment and connection on one side and severance and corruption on the other. Patience, spending across visibility, and answering harm with good become practical maintenance operations on a covenantal network, not only private merits.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies the standard by which covenant performance is maintained.
Repeated preservation and care supply the temporal work required by an enduring commitment.
A confirmed compact supplies the binding structure that the focus's practices keep intact.
Maintaining relation and refusing estrangement supply the positive network operation adjacent to the focus.
Severing connection and estrangement supply the exact failure mode opposed to that maintenance.
Departure from soundness supplies the system-level result when bonds are cut rather than repaired.

structural_cues: 13:20-21 move from keeping a compact to joining what must be joined; 13:22 gives the practices; 13:25 mirrors the sequence with breaking, cutting, and corrupting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a flanking connect-versus-cut architecture; I infer that the focus names mechanisms that preserve the connections. The alternative is that each ayah lists independent traits and consequences without a network function.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an individual's patient piety and generosity.
changed_reading.after: The focus describes how a person keeps a social covenant from tearing: sustain, transfer resources, and repair injury with good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The outcome is entered with sound kin, repeatedly entered by messengers from every gate, and greeted as safety explicitly because of patience. This turns the focus's closing dwelling into relationally inhabited peace and directly confirms patience as causal preparation for it.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies the enacted transition from promised outcome to inhabited place.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the quality by which family relations join the destination.
An entrance supplies permeability and repeated arrival rather than a sealed private reward.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the lived condition produced inside the outcome.
Held self-restraint supplies the explicitly named reason for the greeting and outcome.
Final consequence supplies the repeated closure that confirms the focus's endpoint.
Residence and belonging supply the outcome as a place occupied in peace.

structural_cues: 13:23 places family and repeated entry immediately after the focus; 13:24 directly repeats patience, aftermath, and dwelling with a causal because-of relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly ties patience to greeting and outcome; I infer that the dwelling is defined by relationally inhabited safety. The alternative is that family entry and greeting are reward details without redefining the focus's closing phrase.

changed_reading.before: The patient receive a good residence at the end.
changed_reading.after: Their practiced non-retaliation prepares an inhabitable peace into which repaired relations and welcoming presences can enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is explicitly expanded for some and narrowed for others, while worldly use is temporary. Spending from what was provided is therefore proportional onward circulation under unequal allocations, not generosity measured by an absolute stock.

activation_trace.role: Expansion, abundance, and surplus supply one end of the variable allocation range.
An apportioned gift supplies the repeated reminder that the resource arrives before it is spent.
Narrowing to a small measure supplies the other end of the allocation range.
Temporary usable benefit supplies the resource's limited tenure and weakens possessive attachment.
Outward expenditure supplies the required response to whatever measure has been received.

structural_cues: 13:26 places expansion and restriction around the same provision root used in the focus and then relativizes worldly utility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal divine allocation and limited utility; I infer that the focus evaluates faithful release relative to receipt, not sheer amount. The alternative is that 13:26 only explains economic variation and consolation.

changed_reading.before: The virtuous give a portion of their wealth.
changed_reading.after: They pass onward from a variable allotment whose source, scale, and duration deny absolute ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast expands aftermath into flowing water, lasting nourishment, sheltering shade, or consuming fire. The focus's dwelling is thus an ecology sustained by flows and cover, sharpening the baseline's inhabited-aftercondition model.

activation_trace.role: Continuous flowing and spreading supply the sustaining movement inside the good outcome.
Stillness with duration supplies persistence to nourishment rather than a momentary award.
Protective shade supplies environmental cover and relief within the dwelling.
Final consequence names both contrasted outcomes and binds the ecology directly to aftermath.
Kindled fire supplies the consuming counter-environment against which flow, food, and shade are defined.

structural_cues: 13:35 explicitly predicates two contrasted aftermaths, elaborating one with river, lasting produce, and shade and the other with fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit aftermath contrast and its environmental contents; I infer that these contents unpack the focus's dwelling as a lived ecology. The alternative is to treat them as separate reward images with no feedback into 13:22.

changed_reading.before: The closing phrase promises a favorable house or destination.
changed_reading.after: It promises an enduring ecology of beneficial circulation, nourishment, and cover, contrasted with an ecology that consumes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later divine pair of erasing and fixing activates a two-operation reading of the focus: prayer maintains a stable positive pattern while good action removes the effective trace of bad. The analogy concerns operation, not equality between divine and human agency.

activation_trace.role: Removal of a trace supplies the subtractive operation that clarifies what moral counteraction can accomplish.
Strengthening and fixing in place supply the constructive operation paired with removal.
Maintenance and guardianship supply the human practice that keeps the positive pattern standing.
Beneficent action supplies the positive material used in the focus's subtractive response.
Moral badness supplies the trace or pattern targeted by that response.

structural_cues: The paired verbs erase/fix in 13:39 echo the focus's paired operations of maintaining prayer and repelling bad with good, but the grammatical subjects differ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a divine erase-and-fix pair and a human maintain-and-repel pair; I infer operational analogy while preserving different agents and scales. The alternative is that decree in 13:39 is wholly unrelated to ethical repair in 13:22.

changed_reading.before: Prayer adds merit and good behavior opposes wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The practices form a two-part edit: establish a durable positive pattern and erase the continuing trace of harm through beneficent action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines branch-distant material senses of stopper, conduit, hollow, residue, and circulation. It remains anchored to the focus's exact endurance, expenditure, hidden/public, aftermath, and dwelling sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a systems analogy, never as the lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from held endurance to provision leaving through hidden and public modes, then counterforce, residue, and dwelling.

activation_trace.role: A stopper sealing an opening supplies controlled containment and lets endurance be pictured as holding pressure.
A tunnel with an outlet supplies routed release and pictures spending as flow through a conduit.
A hollow shaft or channel supplies concealed interior transit before anything becomes visible.
Emergence into manifest visibility supplies the exposed outlet of the same routed action.
A remainder left after a process supplies the durable residue produced by repeated moral routing.
Circulation and enclosure supply the system boundary in which that residue becomes an environment.

changed_reading.before: A sequence of inward patience followed by outward acts.
changed_reading.after: A pressure-managed circuit: contain reactive force, route provision through concealed and exposed outlets, use good as counterforce, and inhabit what remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the two-faced branch is not the default sense of the focus's face term. It remains anchored by the singular sought face and the immediate secret/public pair; downstream prose should use it as an integrity test across audiences, not accuse the subjects of duplicity or redefine the divine face.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One sought face governs conduct performed in two opposed visibility modes.

activation_trace.role: The image of two inconsistent faces supplies the latent failure mode against which one orientation is tested.
A single direction and destination supply the coherent alternative to audience-dependent faces.
Interior concealment supplies the private condition in which one possible social face cannot be inspected.
Public manifestation supplies the condition in which another social face could be performed.

changed_reading.before: Sincerity means seeking the Lord while giving both privately and publicly.
changed_reading.after: The one sought Face audits whether the giver remains one person across two visibility regimes instead of producing a private face and a public face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the offspring branch inside a word normally read here as final outcome. It remains anchored by that focus word and the immediate entry of sound parents and spouses in 13:23; downstream prose should retain it as a secondary lineage and household resonance, not displace the eschatological outcome.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The aftermath term carries a latent descendant sense just before the context opens the dwelling to family relations.

activation_trace.role: Children and descendants supply a lineage sense of what remains after a person.
Residence and belonging supply the household frame within which lineage consequence can be inhabited.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the condition carried into the family grouping.
Parenthood and nurture supply the upward generational relation named immediately after the focus.
The marriage pair supplies the lateral household relation joined to the outcome.

changed_reading.before: The individual actor receives a later dwelling.
changed_reading.after: The actor's aftermath also resonates as a household and lineage consequence, with repaired relations among what remains after the self.

strongest_changes: The virtue list became a visibility-invariant stewardship and repair circuit.
Good acting against bad became both a temporal reversal and a separation process that ejects waste while preserving benefit.
The final dwelling became a relational and ecological after-condition generated by successive traces, not merely an appended prize.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated roots and flanking oppositions made 13:22 a hinge between bad-before-good and good-against-bad, connection and cutting, hidden and witnessed action, passing foam and durable benefit. Branch-distant pressure-routing, two-face, and lineage activations remained live under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Several causal links are reader-supplied from sequence and reversal; the context can also be read as juxtaposed examples.
The material conduit and two-face readings are analogical activations, not default lexical senses.
The relational and ecological dwelling models should coexist with, not erase, the ordinary final-outcome reading.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. Shared `د ر ء/B001` has variants converging on warding and pushing away, including penalty. Syntax supplies the arrow: good is the instrument repelling evil. I infer interception of evil's onward effect, not mere replacement in a ledger.
2. `ع ق ب/B005` is succession. Patience, prayer, expenditure, and repelling culminate in `عُقْبَى`; I infer that the abode follows from repeated practice rather than arriving as an unrelated prize.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:34's absent protector showed retrospectively that the protective barrier must be built through these earlier practices.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A directed maintenance cycle turns received provision into counterforce.** `ص ب ر / B001` is self-restraint from panic, `و ج ه / B002` is orientation and direction, `ن ف ق / B002` is wealth going out as expenditure, and `د ر ء / B001` is warding off and pushing away. The actions progress from holding the self, through orienting and establishing worship, to releasing provision and actively repelling bad with good; `ع ق ب / B006` then names the end and outcome. Nearby 13:17 distinguishes useful remainder, 13:20-21 establish covenantal continuity, 13:25 presents the inverse destructive chain, and 13:26 varies provision. I assign patience the role of stabilizer, orientation the role of target, expenditure the role of transfer, and good the role of directional counterforce. The packet supplies these operations; I infer stabilized orientation -> resource outflow -> displacement of harm. The ayah reads as a working system for preserving connected life, not a loose virtue list.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:25's inverse chain made the fixed sequence's causal unity visible: undoing, cutting, and corrupting reverse restraint, orientation, outflow, and warding. 13:26's variable provision further clarified that expenditure is circulation of a received measure, not proof of autonomous abundance.

findings.text: İyilik, kötülüğün ardından yalnızca yeni bir kayıt oluşturmaz; onun ilerleyen etkisini karşı yönde iterek keser.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Kin Gathered Into a Durable Abode
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Related persons are joined, admitted, and settled together in a protected dwelling.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lineage and architecture converge through acts of joining and admission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lineage and Joined Kin
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parents, spouses, descendants, and affiliated kin form a continuing household line.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: parenthood and nurture (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`); marital spouse (`quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`); kinship through the womb (`quranic:root_000552:B002/m01`); descendants remaining after a person (`quranic:root_001033:B004/m01`); affiliation or attribution to a group (`quranic:root_001655:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:21 `يَصِلُون` (و ص ل); 13:22, 13:24 `عُقْبَى` (ع ق ب); 13:23 `آبَائِهِم` (ء ب و) and `أَزْوَاجِهِم` (ز و ج); 13:30 `الرَّحْمَن` (ر ح م).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Parenthood, marriage, womb-kinship, descendants, and affiliation construct a household across generations. Entry into the garden preserves relation rather than dissolving it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Kin Gathered Into a Durable Abode
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Related persons are joined, admitted, and settled together in a protected dwelling.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lineage and architecture converge through acts of joining and admission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Entry, Gates, and Settled Residence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The household enters a planted enclosure through gates and takes up a stable station in safety.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); entry into an interior (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); gate as entrance (`quranic:root_000163:B001/m01`); home and settled station (`quranic:root_001492:B003/m01`); residence in a place (`quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`); safety and freedom from harm (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `أَقَامُوا` (ق و م); 13:23 `جَنَّات` (ج ن ن), `يَدْخُلُون` (د خ ل), and `بَاب` (ب و ب); 13:24 `سَلَام` (س ل م); 13:27 `أُنْزِلَ` (ن ز ل).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Garden, entrance, gate, station, and safety make a coherent arrival scene. Peace is the condition of the inhabited interior, not a detached salutation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Provision Allotted, Opened, and Spent
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision moves through allocation, expansion or restriction, expenditure, and temporary enjoyment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Gift, ration, household expense, and travel stock reveal provision as a circulation system.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Allotment and Expenditure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A measured share is given as food or benefit and then released in support of others.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: apportioned gift or share (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); food entering and sustaining the body (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); money going out in household or sacred expenditure (`quranic:root_001537:B002/m01`); beneficial action exceeding bare justice (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `رَزَقْنَاهُم` (ر ز ق), `أَنْفَقُوا` (ن ف ق), and `الحَسَنَة` (ح س ن); 13:26 `الرِّزْق` (ر ز ق).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Allocation supplies both edible sustenance and spendable benefit; expenditure then moves that share outward as enacted good.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Harm is met by holding the self steady and redirecting aggression through a better action.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Patience becomes restraint and surety, while moral response becomes deflection rather than passive endurance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Held Self and Enduring Surety
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person restrains panic, remains with the obligation, and bears responsibility through difficulty.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: holding the self back from panic (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); surety and continuing responsibility (`quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`); seeking or pursuing an intended end (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); stable beneficial action (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `صَبَرُوا` (ص ب ر), `ابْتِغَاء` (ب غ ي), and `الحَسَنَة` (ح س ن); 13:24 `صَبَرْتُم` (ص ب ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Restraint, continued responsibility, and directed seeking form an active endurance scene. Patience holds both the person and the obligation in place.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Deflection by Better Conduct
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An incoming harm is turned aside through measured, non-colliding response.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: pushing harm away from one's side (`quranic:root_000466:B001/m01`); protective conciliation instead of collision (`quranic:root_000466:B008/m01`); beneficial or gracious action (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`); badness and injury (`quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `يَدْرَءُون` (د ر ء), `الحَسَنَة` (ح س ن), and `السَّيِّئَة` (س و ء).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The better act functions as a deflector: it changes the path of harm through controlled engagement. This is a mechanism of redirection, not a broad moral contrast.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı, kişinin sarsıntı ve yakınma karşısında kendini tutması, aklın ve doğru sayılan davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kalması olarak kurar. Bu yüzden ruhsal dayanma ile zorla alıkoyma, öldürme, güvence verme ve somut nesne adları birbirinden ayrılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal içsel özdenetim ve dayanıklılıkla sınırlıdır; dışarıdan zorla tutma ya da özel kalıp anlamları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca genel özdenetim ve dayanma çekirdeğini verir, kalıba bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Sarsıntı, sıkıntı ya da istenmeyen bir durum karşısında kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyması ve doğru bildiği tutumu kararlılıkla sürdürmesidir.

facets.statement: Kişi, sarsıntı ve yakınma dürtüsüne karşı kendini tutar.
Bu kendini tutma, aklın ve doğru davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kararlı kalmayı içerir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı sarsıntının karşıtı olan, kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyup gereken tutumda kalmasını sağlayan bir özdenetim olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tepkiyi denetleyip doğru görülen tutumu sürdürme çekirdeğinin tamamı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kendini tutmayı hem de güçlük karşısında kararlı kalmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıkıntı veya yıkım karşısında taşkın tepki vermeden dirençli kalmayı anlatan bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Güçlük karşısında sağlam ve denetimli kalma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Aklın ya da doğru davranışın gerektirdiği her durumda kendini tutma kapsamını daraltır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبر بوصفه حبس النفس وثباتها على ما يقتضيه العقل والشرع، وضده الجزع والجبن والضجر بحسب الموضع.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس قتل الصبر ولا يمين الصبر ولا الكفالة ولا أسماء النبات والحجارة.
